title: Sửa modal tạo mẫu bàn trên điện thoại
rootCause: CustomTableModelBuilderModal renders a legacy DOM contract while its original SCSS primarily targets a newer builder contract. The shared modal wrapper, direct tab buttons, unclassified form controls and the one-column phone breakpoint therefore receive incomplete or conflicting styles. Because later global responsive styles load after the component SCSS, the close control and layout can also be stretched again on portal-rendered mobile views.
